'''Justin Lang 15x Imperial Command Domination (a k a 'The Engine') v2''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Justin Lang]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15591">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15591 15x Imperial Command Domination (a k a  'The Engine') v2], DeckTech (Justin "Houjix" Lang, 26 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15591/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15591/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Justin Lang]]
* '''Published:''' 26 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''15x Imperial Command Domination (a k a  'The Engine') v2''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 SYCFA Lang DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Dark space deck designed to either destroy in space or win the drain race against ground. Huge early activation.
